name: stepwarden
description: Verifies every agent tool call before it executes. Five parallel Jev questions, three outcomes — allow, ask, block — with tunable thresholds, a per-tool skip list and a full audit trail. Installs in audit mode: it logs every decision and blocks nothing until you run /stepwarden enforce. Proof of concept on Claude Code function hooks + Jev early access.
author: Stefan Trockel
